headline: Four evidence contracts survive live verification; seven tempting fixes were rejected before they could manufacture green.

items.title: Canonical startup contract dossier
items.insight: Three reproducible control-plane defects get one precise Ark dossier instead of three local workarounds. Trace identity, saturation list parsing, and warm-brief freshness each receive executable acceptance criteria.
items.evidence: trace lock inference exits red · session-floor listRemaining=null · warm brief says 28/29 after direct 244/244

items.title: Suite-derived closeout truth
items.insight: The closeout board will read the suite receipt instead of a hand-copied counter. Malformed or red diagnostics stay dark, while a green 244-step run stamps its own cardinality and timestamp.
items.evidence: diagnostics 244/244 · legacy helper measures only 29 wrappers · autopilot has no post-suite stamp

items.title: External-wait actionability guard
items.insight: The Genius List stops calling a telemetry wait local work. The RUM item remains visible, but it cannot pressure an agent to invent the fresh observations its own text forbids.
items.evidence: current NOW item is tagged EXTERNAL · newest RUM row 24d old · 0 sufficient routes

items.title: Complete proof-surface receipt
items.insight: Every command in the proof orchestrator becomes measurable, including advisories that currently vanish after console output. Blocking behavior stays unchanged while timing and failure ownership become complete.
items.evidence: outer step 20.637s · inner receipt 16.761s · sixteen advisory spawns are unrecorded

followUps: Implement all four at the L3 depth rung, then regenerate and exhaust the innovation pack.
